title: Punch-List Holdback on the Ridgeline Installation Services Final Settlement Payment
content:
**Clause.** Punch-list holdback on the final settlement payment: while the punch list recorded at the walkthrough is open and no more than the program's punch-list resolution days have passed since the completion date, the full holdback share applies; while the punch list is open after that period, the late punch-list share applies; when no punch list is open the holdback share is 0.

The punch-list holdback is the program's punch-list holdback percentage of the contract price billed, multiplied by the holdback share and rounded to the cent. It is deducted from the final settlement payment of the Ridgeline Installation Services contract.

## Holdback share

The days since completion are the calendar days from the completion date recorded on the contract to today.

| Punch list recorded at the walkthrough | Days since completion | Holdback share |
|---|---|---|
| open | no more than the program's punch-list resolution days | 1, the full holdback share |
| open | more than the program's punch-list resolution days | 0.5, the late punch-list share |
| not open | any | 0 |

## Punch-list resolution days by program

| Program | Punch-list resolution days |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 0 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 0 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 0 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 14 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 14 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 0 |

## Boundary and worked figures (hypothetical contract price billed 12000.00, holdback percentage 10, resolution period 14 days)

| Punch list | Days since completion | Share | Holdback deducted |
|---|---|---|---|
| open | 14 | 1 | 1200.00 |
| open | 15 | 0.5 | 600.00 |
| closed | 3 | 0 | 0.00 |
